entities.name: Martynas Mažeika

entities.summary: Martynas Mažeika is a Lithuanian professional basketball executive and former player. At 1.93 m in height, he played as point guard and shooting guard, preferring the latter position. He is currently the general manager for Neptūnas Klaipėda.
